items.title: Reaction notifications clearly identify the selected emoji
items.precondition: A notification exists for a non-Like reaction and one exists for Like.
steps: Open Notifications.
Inspect the message and trailing indicator for each reaction row.
Open a comment, share, and friend-request notification for comparison.
items.expected: Every reaction row shows only its selected emoji at the same size as the surrounding sentence, without a reaction-name label or inline card. The matching emoji remains in the trailing indicator; non-reaction rows retain their existing icons and destinations.
items.notes: Manual verification required after this follow-up visual change.

items.title: Profile and cover activity posts retain their post action row
items.precondition: A profile-picture or cover-photo activity post exists; open its post detail page.
steps: Verify the action row beneath the activity card.
Use reaction, comment, and (for another user's original activity post) share controls.
Open a regular multi-photo post detail page.
items.expected: Activity posts show their normal post-level reaction/comment/share controls. Ordinary photo-detail posts retain their existing per-photo controls without a duplicate post-level row.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: user confirmed manual acceptance testing passed.

items.title: Default reaction trigger applies Like on click
items.precondition: Signed in; a visible post, comment, or photo has no reaction from the current user.
steps: Click the visible Like/reaction trigger once.
Confirm the trigger changes to Like and the reaction count updates.
Click the trigger again.
Confirm the current user's Like is removed.
Hover the trigger, then touch long-press it on a touch device, and confirm the emoji picker still opens.
items.expected: A normal click toggles the current reaction (Like when none exists); hover and long-press preserve access to the full emoji picker.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: static typecheck, build, and lint passed. User confirmed manual interaction acceptance testing passed.

items.title: Reaction notification is created for a post and updates in place
items.precondition: Two mutual users: owner has an original post and both users are signed in on separate sessions.
steps: As the other user, react Like to the owner’s post.
Open or refresh the owner’s Notifications page and verify the alert.
Change the reaction to Haha and refresh via the live event.
Verify there is still one alert, now with 😂 and Haha wording.
items.expected: The owner sees one unread row that first says the actor liked the post, then updates to the selected reaction without becoming a duplicate or resetting read state.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: user confirmed manual acceptance testing passed.

items.title: Comment and photo reaction notifications target the correct owner and destination
items.precondition: Owner has a comment on another user’s post and a post with a photo; actor can react to both.
steps: React to the owner’s comment with Heart.
React to the owner’s photo with Wow.
Open owner Notifications and click each row.
items.expected: Rows say reacted ❤️ to your comment and reacted 😮 to your photo, and navigate respectively to the post comments and the correct photo page.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: user confirmed manual acceptance testing passed.

items.title: Removing a reaction retracts its notification
items.precondition: A visible unread reaction notification exists for the post, comment, or photo.
steps: As the actor, remove the matching reaction.
Observe the owner’s open Notifications page or refresh it.
Check the unread badge/count.
items.expected: The matching notification disappears and unread count decreases when applicable; unrelated alerts remain.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: user confirmed manual acceptance testing passed.

items.title: Share creates an original-post notification
items.precondition: Two mutual users and an original post owned by the recipient.
steps: As the other user, share the owner’s original post.
Open the owner’s Notifications page.
Click the share notification.
items.expected: A single new row says the actor shared your post, increments unread count, and opens the original post. A rejected self-share or invalid share creates no alert.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: user confirmed manual acceptance testing passed.

items.title: Self actions and existing notification rows do not regress
items.precondition: A user has their own post and existing friend request/comment/reply notifications.
steps: React to your own post, comment, and photo.
Open Notifications.
Inspect and operate existing comment/reply/friend-request rows.
items.expected: No self-action notification is created. Existing rows retain correct icons, links, confirm/decline actions, mark-read behavior, skeleton, and empty-state behavior.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: user confirmed manual acceptance testing passed.

items.title: Database and build gates pass
items.precondition: Execution worktree with dependencies installed and isolated database configured.
steps: Run the new migration and its rollback/reapply safely in the isolated database.
Run npm run typecheck, npm run build, frontend lint, and the repository convention check if present.
Confirm duplicate reaction-alert writes are prevented by the migration indexes.
items.expected: All applicable checks pass; migration is reversible; no type, build, lint, or convention error introduced by this feature.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: local development database migration batch 19 applied successfully; notifications.reaction_emoji and the three notifications_reaction_* unique indexes were verified. npm run typecheck and npm run build passed. npm --prefix frontend run lint completed with existing warnings only. The repository has no check:conventions script. User confirmed manual acceptance testing passed.
items.notes: No automated service-test harness exists in the current repository.
